    (4, 'b', 4.0, NULL, true)) t(id, g, c, w, p) DECIDE x(INT), y(INT)
        SUCH THAT max(x + y) by (t.g) <= t.c AND x <= 9 AND y <= 9 MAXIMIZE sum(x)
